- Cheat code for Dragon Quest IX
- Displays AT 32bit seed/15bit return value, BT 64bit seed, CT 64bit seed
- Activate by opening battle records, then finish a battle (no fleeing) to enable BG2 on the field
- Special thanks to DaisukeDaisuke
